company.name: Parcelle
company.distributes: Luxury gift hampers with chocolate-coated jellies, coconut rough, shortbread and panettone from Coco Maison
company.channels_supplied: Corporate gifting for clients such as McGrath, MPC and Rakuten Advertising, with orders of up to 500 gift boxes, plus online sales to shoppers
what_they_do_well: Handles large corporate orders, including one client order of 500 gift boxes cited on its home page.
company.fit_rationale: Sydney luxury hamper company that curates its hampers in-house from third-party gourmet brands. Its Christmas gift boxes carry branded chocolate and biscuits and it handles large corporate orders, so Diablo's chocolate and biscuits fit. Storage: sells from its own stock with a production floor team in Sydney, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Pharmacy 4 Less
company.distributes: Healthy, low calorie and low carb snacks, sugar free sweets and a health food pantry range from other brands, alongside pharmacy and vitamins
company.channels_supplied: Over 50 discount pharmacy stores nationwide and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Serving customers since 2007 and grown to over 50 stores nationwide.
company.fit_rationale: A discount pharmacy chain of over 50 stores whose own shop has a health food section with a snacks category and a Sugarless brand page, a clear home for Diablo's no added sugar bars, sweets and chocolate. It already lists Sugarless Confectionery, a direct sugar free competitor.

company.name: Pushys
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars, protein bites and endurance bars from Maurten, Clif Bar, SIS, GU, Styrkr, Em's Power Bites and High5
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop plus stores with click and collect
company.fit_rationale: Online bike retailer with physical stores and a dedicated bars section from seven nutrition brands. Store count and head office city not stated on the page read.

company.name: Quality Vend
company.distributes: Snacks, drinks, healthy food and meals for office micro markets and autonomous convenience stores, stocked with national and international brands
company.channels_supplied: Offices and workplaces in Sydney and Melbourne
company.sf_brands_carried: Healthy vending line; brands not named
what_they_do_well: Founded in November 2012 and serving over 70,000 customers each week.
company.fit_rationale: A managed micro market operator for Sydney and Melbourne offices that buys national and international branded snacks and sells them to staff as they are. Its office focus and healthy vending line suit Diablo's better for you snacks. Storage: Melbourne site in Craigieburn listed with a warehouse facility.

company.name: Rebel Sport
company.distributes: Protein bars from other brands (Muscle Nation) alongside sports equipment and clothing
company.channels_supplied: National sports store chain and its online shop
company.fit_rationale: National sports shop chain that sells protein bars from other brands online and in store, a food shelf for health-conscious shoppers. Diablo's muesli bars and sugar-free chocolate bars fit next to them. Store count is not stated on the page checked.

company.name: Santos Organics
company.distributes: Organic groceries with Chocolates and Chips, Crackers & Snacks collections, carrying chocolate brands such as Loco Love and Chow Cacao, plus drinking chocolate
company.channels_supplied: Its stores in Byron Bay and Mullumbimby, a shop and warehouse at the Byron Arts & Industrial Estate, and its online shop delivering Australia wide
what_they_do_well: Runs as a not for profit social enterprise delivering organic groceries Australia wide from its Byron Bay base.
company.fit_rationale: A not for profit organic retailer with stores in Byron Bay and Mullumbimby and a national online shop that has dedicated chocolate and snack collections from other brands. Its health-conscious Byron shoppers suit Diablo's vegan muesli bars, wafers and chocolate. It sells from its own stores and warehouse.

company.name: Snack Box Hampers
company.distributes: Chocolate and snack gift hampers and gift boxes built from Cadbury, Lindt, Darrell Lea, KitKat, Maltesers, Milky Bar, Tim Tam biscuits, Allen's and Quality Street
company.channels_supplied: Own online shop with Australia-wide and international delivery, corporate and seasonal hampers
what_they_do_well: Builds hampers from over a dozen major chocolate and biscuit brands, with city pages for Easter delivery.
company.fit_rationale: An online hamper seller whose boxes are filled with packs of branded chocolate, biscuits and lollies sold as they are, including corporate and Easter ranges. Diablo's gift boxes, chocolate bars and advent calendars fit its seasonal hampers; head office is not stated.

company.name: Taste Organic
company.distributes: Certified organic groceries with branded chocolate (Loving Earth), snacks (Kitz) and nut spreads (Food to Nourish), plus vegan and gluten free foods
company.channels_supplied: Its Sydney stores (click and collect sites for Enmore and Turramurra) and its online click and collect shop
what_they_do_well: Features its suppliers, such as Loving Earth and Food to Nourish, on a dedicated Our Suppliers page.
company.fit_rationale: A Sydney organic grocer with at least two stores whose own supplier page names the chocolate, snack and spread brands it sells. Its vegan and gluten free shelves suit Diablo's vegan spreads, jams and muesli bars. Exact store count is not stated on its website.

company.name: United Petroleum (Quickstop)
company.distributes: Snacks, food, drinks and groceries, including muffins and cookies from other brands (Pie Face)
company.channels_supplied: United Petroleum service stations with Quickstop convenience stores, expanding in Victoria
what_they_do_well: Opened two new sites in Melbourne's west, Truganina and Yarraville, in September 2024.
company.fit_rationale: Fuel and convenience network whose Quickstop stores sell snacks, cookies, muffins and groceries from other brands. Diablo's cookies, cakes and chocolate fit its snack range. Site count is not stated on its website.

company.name: Wholefood Merchants
company.channel: Gluten free and free from shops
company.distributes: Chocolate, sweets, biscuits, cakes and cookies, snack bars and nut butters and fruit spreads, with gluten free and allergy friendly ranges
company.channels_supplied: Large store in Ferntree Gully and its own online shop with Australia-wide delivery
what_they_do_well: Over 35,000 products in store and more than 6,000 online, with over 20 years in the health food trade.
company.fit_rationale: A large health food store with dedicated gluten free and allergy friendly ranges and categories for chocolate, sweets, biscuits and cookies, snack bars and spreads from health brands. Diablo's stevia sweetened ranges suit its free from shoppers in store and online.
